Our services

Care for every
stage of life.

Explore the medical, rehabilitation, and diagnostic services described in our center’s profile.

Primary care

Preventive care, diagnosis and treatment of illnesses, and management of chronic conditions. Regular checkups and screenings support ongoing health.

Plan your visit ↗

Children’s care

Pediatric services include routine checkups, immunizations, and care for acute and chronic illnesses in infants, children, and adolescents.

Plan your visit ↗

Women’s health

The center’s profile lists gynecology, obstetrics, and reproductive health services, with a focus on personalized care.

Plan your visit ↗

Specialty care

The profile lists cardiology, endocrinology, gastroenterology, neurology, and orthopedics. Confirm the availability of the relevant specialist before traveling.

Plan your visit ↗

Emergency care

The center’s profile describes an emergency department operating 24 hours a day, seven days a week. Regular clinic and specialist hours may differ.

Plan your visit ↗

Rehabilitation

Physical therapy supports recovery after injury, surgery, or medical conditions. The rehabilitation team develops personalized treatment plans around each patient’s needs and goals.

Plan your visit ↗

Laboratory services

An on-site laboratory provides diagnostic testing to support patient care. Confirm availability of a particular test with the center.

Imaging

The center’s profile lists the Butterfly IQ3 imaging device as part of its diagnostic facilities. Confirm whether the examination you need is available.

Service descriptions follow the center’s profile. Specialist schedules, fees, and visit requirements are not yet listed on this website.
